caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped wooden plaque with a bas-relief carving of a tree at its center. The tree has a thick brown trunk with multiple branches and is adorned with large, lobed leaves that are depicted with a muted green-blue color. The wooden texture of the plaque is detailed, showing cracks and a weathered appearance around the edges. Behind the tree, faintly inscribed into the wood, are the characters "N 32", partially obscured by the tree's trunk and roots. The plaque sits on a plain, light beige background. At the lower right of the image, outside the plaque, the name "ROSE CAMPBELL GERNE" is written in small, delicate capital letters.
title: Firemark
